translation_snapshot.source: A special shot filled with antimagic sap.
translation_snapshot.target: 灌注了反魔能量的特殊弹头。

translation_snapshot.source: 5 turns after use, mirror yourself across the map (centered around the location you were standing when activated).
translation_snapshot.target: 使用后5回合，将自己镜像到地图上（以激活时所站的位置为中心）。

translation_snapshot.source: Fires a barrage of rockets in radius 2, dealing %d%% steamgun damage as fire.
translation_snapshot.target: 发射火箭弹幕，在 2 码半径内造成 %d%% 火焰蒸汽枪伤害。

translation_snapshot.source: Enhance your grenade with an electrical charge, causing it to deal lightning damage and shock targets for %d turns, reducing stun and pin resistance by 50%%.
translation_snapshot.target: 用电力弹药强化榴弹，造成闪电伤害，震撼敌人 %d 回合，震慑和定身抗性降低50%%。

translation_snapshot.source: "Pesky undead plaguing your village? Necromancers ransacking your burial grounds? The Vindicator is the solution to all your woes!"
translation_snapshot.target: 恼人的不死族在你的村庄传播瘟疫？死灵法师搜刮你的墓地？维序者可以解决一切。

translation_snapshot.source: When you take a hit of more than 10% of your total life the suit's motors activate fo the next turn, displacing you before any blow could hit you.
translation_snapshot.target: 当你受到超过总生命值 10% 的单次伤害后，引擎会在下一回合启动；每当攻击即将命中时，它都会让你自动移位以避开伤害。
